tool_input.command: perl -pi -e 's/await this\.visibleToViewer\(\)/await this.visible()/g' app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts && grep -n "visible" app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts

result:
`bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` is 9/9 green (7 of those are the new draft tests).

I added a draft/published switch to posts. `db/schema.ts` gains a `published` boolean column on `posts` (`integer(..., { mode: 'boolean' }).notNull().default(false)`), with the generated migration in `db/migrations/20260818044547_add_published_to_posts/` extended by an `UPDATE posts SET published = 1` backfill so pre-existing rows stay public — verified against a copy of a populated database — and `db/seeders/002_posts.ts` now inserts its sample posts as published. `app/Models/Post.ts` adds `published` to `fillable` and exports a `visibleToViewer(viewerId)` `where(callback)` group ("published OR authored by the viewer"), which `PostController` applies through a small `visible()` helper to the list, the keyword search, and `show` — the latter now uses `newQuery().where('id', id).where(...).firstOrFail()` so someone else's draft 404s exactly like an unused id; `HomeController`'s latest-posts strip uses the same filter so the landing page doesn't leak drafts either. `PostResource` exposes `published: boolean` on every post object, `PostPayloadSchema` accepts an optional `published` boolean defaulting to `false` (so an untouched create form saves a draft), and the New/Edit pages get a "Published" checkbox wired to that field, with a small "Draft" badge on `posts/Show.tsx`. Edit/update/destroy authorization is unchanged, so other people's posts stay forbidden as before. New feature tests live in `tests/PostDrafts.test.ts`, and the README's post-routes bullet documents the behaviour.
